transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I’m just… worn out. Even getting from the bedroom to the kitchen feels like I’ve been hauling lumber all day. Resting doesn’t really help.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?
Yeah… I have. Most mornings I wake up with this heavy, hopeless feeling, like it’s sitting in my chest. Some days I just end up out in the garage crying, and I don’t even really know what set it off.
Do you find yourself enjoying things you used to like?

Not really. I used to look forward to choir, playing a little pickup ball, working on cars… grilling for the family. Now I just… don’t care enough to go. Half the time I don’t even answer people’s texts.
Have you been feeling anxious or nervous lately?
I don’t know… maybe a little, but that’s not really the main thing. I mostly just feel tired and low.
Have you had any thoughts about hurting yourself?
Yeah… I mean, the thought comes up that I’d be better off dead. I don’t like saying that. When I’m by myself, it scares me, because sometimes I start thinking I might actually do something.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About four months, I guess. Since my wife went back to working full-time… I’ve been alone most weekdays, and it’s just kind of been like this since then.
Have you noticed any significant change in your weight recently?
I haven’t really been keeping track. I don’t think there’s been a big change… nothing I’ve noticed, anyway.
Do you feel like you're moving more slowly than usual or having trouble sitting still?
Yeah… slowed down, mostly. Everything feels like it takes more effort, like I’m moving through mud. Even answering people… I hear them, but it takes me a while to get the words out.
Do you often find yourself fidgeting or having trouble sitting still?
Not really fidgeting… no. It’s more the opposite. I feel slowed down, like everything takes too much effort. People ask me something and I hear it, but it takes me a while to answer.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight over the past four months?
I don’t think so. I haven’t really been weighing myself… but I haven’t noticed anything major.
Have you lost any weight since your wife went back to working full-time?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t been keeping track… I don’t think I’ve noticed a big change.
Do you find yourself pacing back and forth or feeling like you need to be in constant motion?
No… not pacing. It’s more like I can’t get moving. Everything feels slowed down, like I’m trying to move through mud. Even answering takes me a while.
Have you lost a noticeable amount of weight since you started feeling this way?
I don’t know… I haven’t really noticed. My clothes don’t feel that different, I guess.
Have you lost more than 5% of your body weight since you started feeling this way?
I really don’t know. I haven’t weighed myself, so… I couldn’t say if it’s that much.
Have you had to loosen your belt or buy smaller clothes since you started feeling this way?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t had to buy anything smaller. My belt’s about the same, I guess.
Do you feel like you're fidgeting or restless, like you need to be moving around?
Not really fidgeting… it’s more the opposite. Everything feels slowed down, like I’m moving through mud. Even answering takes me a while sometimes.
Have you noticed any change in how your clothes fit since you started feeling this way?
Not that I’ve really noticed. They seem to fit about the same, I think.
Have you lost any weight that you've noticed since you started feeling this way?
Not that I’ve noticed, no. I don’t really weigh myself much.
Have you noticed any change in your appetite since you started feeling this way?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I’ve noticed much of a change.
Have you had any periods of losing weight unintentionally since you started feeling this way?
I don’t think so. I haven’t noticed my weight changing much, at least not that I can tell.
